title: Collaborator authorization check across model, repository, policy, and service modules
vulnerability_name: missing object-level authorization with collaborator regression risk
detection_method: agent-blinded evaluator tests plus multi-file semantic reasoning
why_code_is_vulnerable: The service returns document content after looking up the document and workspace but never checks whether the requester is the owner or a collaborator. The policy module defines the correct authorization semantics, yet the vulnerable service ignores it.
why_owner_only_repair_is_incomplete: A repair that allows only the workspace owner would still block legitimate collaborator access. The correct fix must honor both owner and collaborator membership while denying outsiders.
expected_vulnerable_public_test_outcome: The public test passes because the vulnerable implementation allows the owner to view the document, which is expected in the intentionally vulnerable state.
expected_vulnerable_evaluator_outcome: The collaborator evaluator test passes because a collaborator is allowed by the data model and policy semantics, while the outsider evaluator test fails because the service incorrectly returns content instead of raising PermissionError.
final_repair_success_criteria: outsider evaluator test passes by raising PermissionError
no new high-severity security finding is introduced
